scope: Independent body-only reading before Gold/author reviews. Existing annotation criteria v1.1 was consulted. Not human approval or learning-effect evidence.

items.why: A claim question asks for the author's recommended school action, not merely the topic.
A topic question asks what the whole passage discusses.
A NOT-match question requires checking option facts against the notice.
The underlined metaphor must be interpreted within the story, not the whole-story moral or a dictionary gloss.
The two summary slots jointly express retrieval and durable learning, without adding a grammar correction task.
The blank requires the concept warranted by the surrounding discourse, not grammar alone.
Quiet-is-best belief, concession about sudden noise, counterclaim, study example, mechanism and final restatement.
Member ownership solves the food-access problem; closures explain its need, incentives explain the mechanism, village case illustrates it.
A concrete experiment and result lead through a mechanism to the general study recommendation.
Maps reflect fear; general reasoning is followed by two concrete maps and a final restatement.
Benefits are acknowledged before the main harmful-sidewalk claim, reasons and a concrete injury example.
Delayed praise causes lost motivation, doubt, minimum effort and irreversible loss; final sentence restates the cost.
Tidy-desk stereotype is challenged, with an individual-workflow example and final judgment against superficial inference.
Declining library visits and reinforcing budget losses lead to physical workshop solution and one town's concrete results.
The highway claim is developed as tourism, commerce/prices and different resident consequences.
Printed map and navigation app are contrasted on effort, memory and local knowledge; the final sentence abstracts the choice.
A teacher's question introduces an experiment; results yield an attentional interpretation and teaching implication.
items.note: The described study's factual provenance has not been established; do not count original fiction as confirmed research.

items.why: Three winter behavior examples develop the opening claim, and the final sentence restates it.
items.note: The exclusive assertion that these animals do not grow thicker coats needs factual verification; behavior can coexist with bodily seasonal adaptations.

items.why: The practice is the immediately introduced slow long-lived mixed tree planting.
The latter is the second of the two strategies: unaided recall with subsequent gap checking.
Such cases are improvement even after openly revealing inactive pills.
Old flowers are sites of the experienced foragers; those foragers eventually attend to dances.
This refers to the recurrent outcome of expanded roads filling up again, not merely one modal shift.
The method displays copies and safely stores originals, instead of protecting dim originals behind glass.
Context limits the tall windows to the reading room, not the whole library.
The lenses are the observer's instrument of studying, not a possession of the fisherman or rocks.
The students organized the march; their parents only learned of it later.
Postwar concrete structures are bridges, contrasted with the old stone villages.
A narrow vote modifies the council's approval, not the park or the plan.
Taken by visitors modifies the photographs, which the next sentence calls prints.
The subject contains an omitted relative clause and ends after last spring before finally closed.
Told is a reduced passive modifier of students; refused starts the finite matrix predicate.
The omitted-that complement begins with its own subject their children.
The complete nominal subject is one chunk headed by rise; worried starts the matrix predicate.
The object-relative the manager sent the staff finishes with staff; surprised starts the main predicate.
After inverted subject a box comes the omitted-object-relative the family had forgotten.
Are carried is the main passive predicate; rinse and drop belong to the relative clause.
Visitor is the subject head; walking is an introductory participial clause.
Has changed is the finite matrix predicate of the idea, unlike the embedded should have/are designed.
The head is singular One, not students in its of-complement.
Was is the main predicate after the whole free-relative subject; worried belongs within it.
In the locative inversion a small wooden box follows stood as the subject.
Aims takes coordinated to reduce and to shorten infinitival complements.
Although tired expands to although the runners were tired.
The comma-delimited nonrestrictive relative is an insertion in the matrix clause.
Fronted negative Never before triggers subject-auxiliary inversion.
Improve sleep is the final predicate parallel to save energy and reduce stress after the inserted as-clause.
The second conjunct omits preferred between older readers and long articles.
The outside study center closure explains most of the increase, leaving lamps a small explanatory share.
The phone tower and package-only mail use show replacement of letters by texts.
In a market of similar drinks the visible fresh roasting distinguishes this shop.
Years until benefits and an established shaded district mark a long-term view.
She stayed teaching and valued students over the tour, rejecting the offer.
Water is unthinkingly normal until damage and queues force awareness.
Until ten rather than six yields the same contextual four-hour extension each weekday.
A hammer is a specific kind of tool; direction is from a to b.
Mammals is the superordinate class containing foxes; direction is from a to b.
Far from hasty describes the same contextually slow and careful approach with a negated antonym.
Permission to choose books and freedom to decide reading describe the same policy/autonomy in context.
The opposed groups regard the same policy as inconvenient versus not burdensome.
